definition: Natural log of AVONET species-mean Tail.Length divided by species-mean Wing.Length; ratio of means, not a specimen-level mean ratio or allometric residual.
source: Pinned AVONET v7 workbook, AVONET2_eBird sheet; positive finite lengths, Inference=NO and Complete.measures>=4.
cohort: Reuse the existing exact Animalia/Aves name join and original whole-genus train/validation/test assignments; independently recheck against corrected species manifest.
representation: Existing expanded_tol10m_v2 raw space-format BioCLIP2 vectors and expanded_stability_w2048_k32_v2 anchor SAE; no SAE retraining or threshold changes.
candidate_pool: Only the 732 features passing the original five-replicate stability gate.

selection.rank: Largest absolute Pearson correlation after subtracting each training family's mean from activation and endpoint; smaller feature ID breaks exact ties.
selection.seal: Save training_selection.json before computing validation endpoint values. No runner-up after failed support or confirmation.

confirmation.association: Family-centered correlation has training-selected sign and two-sided 95% genus-bootstrap interval excludes zero in that sign.
confirmation.prediction: Training-fitted taxonomy-plus-selected-activation has lower held-out species-weighted RMSE than taxonomy alone, with a two-sided 95% genus-bootstrap interval for baseline minus augmented RMSE entirely above zero.
confirmation.support_failure: Stop without computing or analyzing endpoint values for that confirmation split; record insufficient support. The source workbook itself is parsed for all splits.
confirmation.validation_failure: Stop; do not compute or analyze test endpoint values or launch image generation.
confirmation.test: Only if validation passes every gate, apply the same frozen training-selected feature, sign, training-fitted predictors and support/interval rules to test once. No train+validation refit.

taxonomy_control.baseline: Training family mean shrunk to training order mean shrunk to global mean; unseen family falls back to order, unseen order to global.
taxonomy_control.augmentation: beta*(activation - training-taxonomy-predicted activation), added to baseline endpoint prediction; beta is training within-family least-squares slope with no intercept after family centering.
taxonomy_control.hyperparameters: Fixed here without new label performance inspection; no validation tuning or raw-vector ridge sweep.

bootstrap.method: Sample genera with replacement, retaining every species and multiplicity. Recompute family means within each correlation resample; predictions remain frozen.

multiple_testing: One new endpoint and one training-selected feature; both association and predictive-improvement gates are required. No alternative endpoint/candidate after a failed confirmation in this run.
sequential_research_disclosure: The earlier beak experiment failed and was seen before this endpoint was chosen. The same cohort and SAE are reused, and SAE checkpoints used validation embeddings. This is prospective follow-up analysis for a new endpoint, not a pristine independent project-level test or full phylogenetic control.

image_branch.prerequisite: Validation and test pass every gate; otherwise no tail-image experiment.
image_branch.species_selection: Highest-activation training species for the sealed feature with trait value, existing model coverage uncertainty and species sex/age variation disclosed; smaller scientific-name lexical order breaks ties.
image_branch.calibration: Eight unedited images before feature edits; require at least six measurable images under a separately frozen anatomical-landmark protocol. Tail root and wrist must be identifiable; a silhouette proxy cannot silently replace AVONET geometry.
image_branch.pilot: Only after calibration passes: eight paired seeds, original/reconstruction/removal/half/double/other-active/removal-norm-matched orthogonal random controls. Freeze endpoint, scoring, contrasts and scaling rule before generating edits.
image_branch.large_replication: Only after a scored successful small pilot; use new seeds, a preselected different-genus species and matched features in independently trained SAEs.
image_branch.human_status: Existing32 ladybird human scores do not constitute new tail-image scores. Any AI scores are provisional and separate.

hardware: CPU-only numerical analysis; stop on memory or hardware errors, preserve logs, no automatic fallback or repeated altered runs.
negative_result: Retain failed support/association/control/measurement gates as completed negative findings; do not relabel stable features as biological traits.
